investment_recommendation: Hold (Provisional): Costco's operating margin of 3.85% for fiscal year 2026 [C:operatingmargin2026] trails Walmart (4.18%) and Target (4.88%), while the trailing P/E ratio near 43.58 [C:pe2026] signals valuation caution. Despite strong revenue growth of 10.14% [C:revgrowth2026], improvements in free cash flow of $9.382 billion and operational discipline from the tariff refund effect [C:freecashflow2026] support stability but risks such as cannibalization and regulatory limitations remain significant and constrain more positive outlooks.

Trailing P/E ratio using price of $904.7 and FY 2026 diluted EPS

source.formula: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities - Capital Expenditures
